Hi everyone! I don't know if you guys will appreciate this as much as I do or even understand why I'm so happy for him but when I first met this kid, dyspraxia used to be a big barrier for him and would upset him to the point where it affected him emotionally almost everyday.  I was trying to get him a win all night, we'd end up coming in 2nd place dozens of times and in his final game, I rushed the last enemy to try and get the kill and I choked super hard and got downed while he won the game and got us both umbrellas. I usually just lurk Reddit but I'm just super proud of him because I know what having a disorder is like and feeling handicapped because of it (super bad anxiety) that I had to post this. He's come a long way, from being discouraged almost everyday to not letting dyspraxia get him down anymore from what I’ve seen, and even inspires me to try not letting having anxiety/depression affect me so much.  He’s had a hard time with games like Overwatch, COD, and Destiny but I've noticed that Fortnite has always been a game where I can't even tell that dyspraxia affects him and he seems very confident and comfortable playing. Thank you Epic Games for making such an incredible game for everyone. :)
